test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 10 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af04686a266f40f16a2e28dd0723df4c20534ce81b897a1cadfee3bf64c454ae.png]
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

1) 1 is shift their position in right upper corner in next figure and remains the same till the last figure.

2) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ced01396f15d0591feaaa980b07ef834c4905295fac45638b6fbf7786a95575b.png] is shift their position in upper middle side in next figure and remains the same till the last figure.

3) & is shift their position in upper left corner side in next figure and remains the same till the last figure.

4) $ is shift their position in left middle side in next figure and remains the same till the last figure.

5) 8 is shift their position in left bottom corner in next figure and remains the same till the last figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a50223fa19379ac2851503be20f5373a1d95773a653dc1ef7420df9d2721c81e.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aff5e7e0f026d607de350cfa7f8c03ca0d23c75cd7e3cb58cc510824d27b724a.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
